The effect of amlodipin, a calcium channel blocker, on tendon healing: an experimental study in rat model of Achilles tendon injury. Achilles tendon injuries represent a major clinical challenge due to the tendon's poor vascularity and limited regenerative capacity. Amlodipine, a dihydropyridine calcium channel blocker, has demonstrated antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects in various tissues. results.text: Amlodipine-induced gingival hyperplasia in a Nepalese patient experiencing high dosages: a case report. Amlodipine is a third-generation calcium channel blocker used in the treatment of hypertension. One of the side effects associated with amlodipine is gingival hyperplasia mostly occurring at a higher dose (10 mg).
